keyframes.framing: Wide shot of a desert caravan halted under a tattered cloth canopy: three adults re-bind the big wooden cart wheel at center-right, cargo sacks and jars around, and a huge nearly-empty communal water barrel dominating the foreground left, ash-gold dunes and rock mesas behind.
keyframes.knownDefects: Two small teal hanging signs on the canopy carry glyph-like abstract marks (not legible text, but motif-like); the barrel reads as a wide open vat with debris and a spill puddle beneath it rather than a lidded barrel. Otherwise on-prompt — no ambush, no readable writing.

keyframes.framing: Medium shot in a green bamboo grove: a young man in a blue tunic kneels and pours a thin stream from a small clay flask into a large carved stone communal bowl beside a mossy stone wall and small tiled shrine.
keyframes.knownDefects: Setting contradicts the scene — lush bamboo forest and shrine instead of the ash-gold desert caravan rest of S01, so the water-scarcity context is lost; the figure is a slim young man, not the stocky middle-aged merchant Sam is described as (he recurs identically in S03, so S02/S03 agree with each other but not with the character brief); the communal vessel is a stone basin, not the caravan barrel. The pour itself is modest and glow-free, as prompted.

keyframes.framing: Medium shot on rocky scrub ground: the young man in the blue tunic crouches beside a large blank map cloth weighted with stones, two dark route cords laid across it — one crossing a pile of jagged stones, the other curving toward the shaded side — as he sets down a small bottle and points at the routes.
keyframes.knownDefects: Ground is green-tinged rocky scrub rather than S01's ash-gold desert (cross-shot environment drift, though closer than S02); the figure is the same slim young man as S02, not a stocky middle-aged merchant; he holds a small glass bottle rather than visibly replacing the clay flask. No readable map text, as required.
